display_information.name: Pollito
display_information.description: Team polls with automatic quorum closing, secret ballots, and live progress bars
display_information.long_description:
Pollito is a native Slack app for team polls and fast consensus without messy message threads.

Key Capabilities:
• Public or Anonymous Ballots: Create open polls with visible votes, or switch on double-urn anonymous voting so teammates can participate honestly without social pressure.
• Automatic Quorum & Timer Closing: Set a strict majority quorum target (51%–100% of channel members), a deadline timer, or run casual polls with no threshold. The poll closes and announces the winner or tie the moment consensus is reached.
• Live In-Channel Meters: Real-time vote counts and monospace progress bars updated directly in the message card.
• Channel & Huddle Flexibility: Launch polls in any channel with /pollito, post directly into active Huddle threads with /pollito huddle, or manage reusable templates from App Home.
